_comment: Hand-authored supplements to the sample-derived leaf set, sourced from the inspector stage_map + PRPs/detection-prescription-inventory.md. dynamic_prefixes = containers whose dict keys are chosen at runtime (genre/stem-role/band/feature names) and cannot be enumerated; a consumer path under one resolves to the prefix. manual_leaves = real declared pipeline outputs that happened to be empty (empty list/dict) in every committed sample, so they carry no observed leaf. bare_top_level_allowed = non-final_json keys injected into the flattened analysis at runtime (the verdict pipeline sets track_id).
